title: Artin--Tate finite type descent to an intermediate subalgebra
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], let $B$ be a commutative $R$-algebra of finite type [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra], and let $A\subseteq B$ be an $R$-subalgebra. If $B$ is finitely generated as an $A$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module], then $A$ is of finite type over $R$.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 00IS (lemma-Artin-Tate, line 12297): 'Let R be a Noetherian ring. Let S be a finitely generated R-algebra. If T \subset S is an R-subalgebra such that S is finitely generated as a T-module, then T is of finite type over R.'
